newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BANKS AND COE COMBINE TO SUPPORT CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BANKS AND COE COMBINE TO SUPPORT CHELSEA.

text.p: Britain's new Sports Minister Tony Banks and former Conservative backbencher Seb Coe transcended party political barriers on Thursday by affirming their joint support for Chelsea in the F.A. Cup final.
Banks said he met twice Olympic 1,500 metres champion Coe regularly during home games at the London club, who meet Middlesbrough on Saturday in the showpiece match of the British season.
Coe, who lost his seat at the general election on May 1 won in a landslide by the Labour Party, said he thought Chelsea would win.
"They're playing some very, very good football, he said.
